title: Group Theoretic Constructions of Singular Set in a Long Range Segregation Model
summary: In this paper, we construct several explicit examples of singular sets of Hausdorff dimension $(n-2)$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$ on free boundaries for an elliptic system modeling long range segregation. The system has been previously studied by Caffarelli, Patrizi and Quitalo in \cite{CL2} for the regularity of the free boundary in dimension two, and by the author and Torres in \cite{ChPaTo26_2} for the partial regularity in higher dimensions.
